name: Chitose Sana
source:
[url=/c908]Haruki's[/url] younger sister, kind to everyone, good at housework, whether it’s cooking or laundry, she can handle it all. She has a big brother complex, and is always panicking whenever she says embarrassing things in front of Haruki, and is scared of ghost stories. She also knows a lot of otaku memes.

[Edited from Mayoi's review]
